name: Duckstation
tagline: A PS1 Emulator aiming for the best accuracy and game support.
description: DuckStation is a PS1 Emulator aiming for the best accuracy and game support.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/duckstation:version-latest@sha256:c8ac72a408a78852ff60ac314e450a485271a022f50ffbe737c02bacb3622c86
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
